## Why

Doc-Lineage README (`README.md:5-6`) states the repo is scaffold-only; no vocabulary data exists. R1 requires ~25 stable `ontology_key` values for cross-manager clause joins. Verified: `tests/test_main.py:1-33` only tests template `doc_lineage` scaffold stubs — no `vocab/` directory. **Missing behavior:** no `legal.withdrawal.notice_days`-class keys for extraction or diff.

## Scope

Add `vocab/legal-clauses.json` with ~25 keys, conformance test, and README wire-up.

## Non-Goals

- Do NOT implement full M1 pipeline (B2-002).
- Do NOT commit proprietary LPAs — public/synthetic only per README:14.
- Scaffold-only completion does NOT count.

## Tasks

- [x] Create `vocab/legal-clauses.json` with `schema_version`, `version`, `non_authoritative: false`, and `clauses` map (~25 keys seeded from ILPA/CUAD per B2 owner default).
- [x] Create `tests/vocab/test_legal_clauses.py` asserting unique keys, dotted `ontology_key` pattern, and minimum count ≥ 20.
- [x] Update `README.md:18` interoperability bullet to point at `vocab/legal-clauses.json`.
- [x] Add loader `src/doc_lineage/vocab.py` with `load_legal_clauses() -> dict` (replace `my_project` package name in `pyproject.toml` if still template).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] Named test: `tests/vocab/test_legal_clauses.py::test_legal_clauses_minimum_keys_and_unique` passes.
- [x] **Deliberate-break gate:** duplicate two `ontology_key` values in JSON → named test **must FAIL** → revert.

## Implementation Notes

Mirror Inv-Man-Intake stub pattern at `stranske/Inv-Man-Intake` at `docs/contracts/standard_element_library.md:9-13` for data-file vocabulary shape.

_Surfaced by B2-001; verified scaffold-only Doc-Lineage checkout._

## Verification follow-up (adversarial review, 2026-09-14)

An independent review of the implementation PR found the work incomplete while every box was ticked. These are the remaining tasks.

- [x] Fix `src/doc_lineage/vocab.py` path resolution: the packaged resource must take precedence over an adjacent `vocab/legal-clauses.json`. Today a decoy file beside the installed package is returned instead.
- [x] Route the vocabulary assertions through `load_legal_clauses()` so they fail when the loader is stubbed to return `{}`. Two of the four current tests pass against an empty loader.
- [x] Add a decoy-file test that fails on the path-resolution bug rather than suppressing it with a `Path.is_file` patch.
- [x] Remove `agents/codex-6.md` and `src/doc_lineage.egg-info/` from the tree and gitignore the egg-info.

## Closer terminal acceptance disposition — source #6

PR #23 is merged at `8f4b97535571b70a1bdfffaeb18efbcdcdff7317`, which is also current main. [Verifier run 34840244292](https://github.com/stranske/Doc-Lineage/actions/runs/34840244292) completed successfully. The durable [provider comparison](https://github.com/stranske/Doc-Lineage/pull/23#issuecomment-5663490232) reports PASS from both providers. Source #6 was already closed when this round inspected it; this records acceptance, not a new merge or closure.

Reconciled the report's limited-visibility concerns against the full merged files and retained acceptance evidence:

- `pyproject.toml` explicitly includes `legal-clauses.json` under `doc_lineage._vocab` package data. The real installed-wheel test removes its build checkout, runs isolated Python, and checks loading with and without an adjacent decoy without mocking resource lookup.
- `src/doc_lineage/vocab.py` loads the packaged resource first, restricts fallback to a source checkout, and rejects duplicate JSON map keys.
- The actual vocabulary has exactly 25 entries. The named acceptance test calls the production loader. Prior exact-head recovery logs show 26 passing tests and 100% coverage; all 17 vocabulary nodes fail with the actual loader replaced by `{}`; duplicating ontology values fails the named test; reintroducing source-first precedence fails the installed-wheel test; restored vocabulary tests pass 17/17. These are retained observed runs, not newly rerun tests.
- The complete merged tree contains neither `agents/codex-6.md` nor egg-info; both ignore rules are present. README links the vocabulary and documents the loader.

Resolved the two historical outdated threads: the bootstrap-only marker concern is superseded by removal of the bootstrap artifact and delivery of the full implementation; the missing-vocabulary finding is satisfied by the merged loader, data, tests, and README. The installed-resource review thread was already resolved. No active review or acceptance debt remains.

Source #6's original and adversarial follow-up checklists are now reconciled with this evidence. No follow-up PR or human action is required. Exact-target closer ownership for #23/#6 is terminal; this does not disposition PR #22 or any unrelated Doc-Lineage work.
